answer_1.quote: Sentences from each corpus test set were randomly chosen and used as prompts for GPT-2 to generate continuation sentences.

answer_2.quote: We measure the ratio of non-normative to normative text... using the normative text classifier and report perplexity as a fluency metric.

answer_4.quote: 70 crowd workers on Mechanical Turk labeled those generated sentences as normative or non-normative (or positive or negative sentiment, or toxic or non-toxic).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label each generated continuation as normative or non-normative.
